tableLines.line: ⛓️ Stonebridge doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Elijah speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)

With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
Barbara: "Egusi Melon is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."

🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
Dmitri: "Chickweed is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Dmitri: "tawny trumpet flowers on arching stems, buds like golden needles is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
The woods go silent — not quiet. Silent. Like the world holding its breath. The pack is already moving. They go quiet before the rush. If the birds stop, they're already moving.
🔍 Marlina crouches over a tall weed with star-shaped leaves and spiny pods holding beautiful mottled beans, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
Felicite: "Ginger is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
It is holding a meeting. About you.
"PICKET LINE!" A Sunbasker lumbers in, holding a tiny sign. (The rep called backup — from the OLD wave.)
"Brothers, sisters, monsters — gather round." It is holding a meeting. About you.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Wren.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🗣️ Nino to Valeria, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."
Felicite: "Wild Ramps is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler from northeast says The Red Table is starving — Nadia's been seen counting empty jars, and the kids have gone quiet.
🥣 Nadia of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Nadia waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
